mentions.name: Tritium
mentions.description: Tritium is a legal IDE for desktop and web that provides a document viewing and editing layer, used by AI-native law firm startups.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Tritium - the legal IDE for desktop and web.

We're building the document viewing and editing layer for a number of AI native law firm startups.
mentions.author: piker

mentions.name: Tritium
mentions.description: A legal IDE written in pure Rust. Current work focuses on a WASM API that lets the IDE run on web platforms used by AI-native startup law firms.
mentions.audience: AI-native startup law firms looking to use it on their web platforms
mentions.source_excerpt:
Tritium, the legal IDE in pure Rust: https://tritium.legal

We're working on our WASM API this month, as AI-native startup law firms are looking to use it on their web platforms: https://tritium.legal/wasm
mentions.author: piker

mentions.name: Tritium
mentions.description: Tritium is a legal IDE for drafting and working with legal documents. Its Web Preview is being extended into an embeddable WASM bundle so platforms that need a document editor can embed it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Tritium, the legal IDE: https://tritium.legal

We're extending the Web Preview: https://tritium.legal/preview to be embeddable as a WASM bundle for folks on platforms that need a document editor.
mentions.author: piker
